title: Installed components need accountable inventory and automated unauthorized component response
remediation: Deployment asset and component owners reconcile scoped assets, responsible administrators, assessed configurations and approved deviations with installation, removal and update records. Demonstrate approved automated detection using a synthetic unauthorized component and record the configured response. Use release inventories as evidence for supplier artifacts and verify actual deployments independently.

milestones.title: Collect signed inventory reconciliation, administrator and deviation records, and a sanitized unauthorized-component detection and response receipt
